newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy evacuates 25 foreign missionaries from Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Italy evacuates 25 foreign missionaries from Zaire.

text.p: Italy said it had evacuated 25 foreign missionaries on Saturday from eastern Zaire, where looting has set in after rebel forces routed the army.
A foreign ministry statement said the group included seven Italians as well as several Canadians and Latin Americans.
They were put on special flights from the airport outside the town of Isiro bound for the capital Kinshasa, the statement said.
A similar operation on January 5 moved 80 people to safety from the Isiro region, which the statement said had been "a theatre of violence and looting since the Christmas period".
